text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day after Grass Wonder's day<n>off, I head over
to my office only to<n>find...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I-I'm sorry. I only meant to take a<n>quick rest on
the sofa.
choice_data_list: Did you get enough sleep yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, I sort of lost track of time while<n>gazing at my
moss terrarium last<n>night.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There is an art to growing moss in a<n>glass tank, and
it brings me joy to<n>observe its daily progress.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I need to take care not to let it cutinto my sleep schedule... Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems Grass Wonder stayed up<n>late rather than
get a proper night's<n>rest.
